definitions.explanation: The galaxy containing the solar system, visible as a band of light across the night sky.

examples.japanese: {銀河系|ぎんがけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数千億|すうせんおく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The Milky Way contains hundreds of billions of stars.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{銀河系|ぎんがけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{端|はし}→端：00936_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The sun is located toward the edge of the Milky Way.

examples.japanese: {銀河系|ぎんがけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{巨大|きょだい}→巨大：02586_kyodai⟧な⟦ブラックホール→ブラックホール：28747_burakkuhooru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{考|かんが}えられている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: It is believed that a massive black hole exists at the center of the Milky Way.

notes:
⟦{銀河|ぎんが}→銀河：05051_ginga⟧ (galaxy; Milky Way) + ⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧ (system). Specifically refers to the Milky Way — the galaxy we live in. When discussing other galaxies, the term ⟦{銀河|ぎんが}→銀河：05051_ginga⟧ alone is used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銀河系|ぎんがけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧ — the center of the galaxy
- {銀河系|ぎんがけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧ — outside the galaxy
- {銀河系|ぎんがけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧ — the structure of the galaxy

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{銀河|ぎんが}→銀河：05051_ginga⟧ — galaxy; Milky Way — can refer to any galaxy or to the Milky Way poetically
- ⟦{天の川|あまのがわ}→天の川：05050_amanogawa⟧ — the Milky Way — the traditional Japanese name, associated with the Tanabata festival
- ⟦{宇宙|うちゅう}→宇宙：01861_uchuu⟧ — outer space; the universe
